predictions.selection: Panathinaikos AKTOR Athens to win (money line)
predictions.headline: Panathinaikos AKTOR Athens to win (money line)
predictions.body: Panathinaikos go into Round 7 top of the EuroLeague table, first of twenty after six rounds, and they host this one at the Telekom Center in Athens on Thursday. Baskonia arrive at the other end of the same table: the official game centre lists Kosner Baskonia Vitoria-Gasteiz twentieth, which is dead last. First against last, at home, in a competition where the OLBG community says favourites have landed roughly two of every three money lines this season. Nothing about that reads like a coin flip. Selection: Panathinaikos to win.

predictions.headline: Provence Rugby to win (match result)
predictions.body: Friday night in Aix is the clearest fixture on the Pro D2 card. The league's own calendar shows Provence Rugby sitting second after seven rounds while Béziers are fourteenth of sixteen, and the home side kick off at 21h00 under the lights. OLBG's crowd has not even bothered pricing the straight win: its only market on this game is a Béziers handicap of plus 28.5 points, which tells you how the room sees it. Our line is simpler. Selection: Provence Rugby to win the match outright.

predictions.headline: Stade Toulousain to win (match result)
predictions.body: Toulouse lead the TOP 14 after six rounds and welcome ninth-placed Perpignan to Ernest-Wallon on Saturday afternoon, 16h35 kick-off, live on Canal+. The official LNR table is the whole argument: first hosting ninth, in a league where the home side's record against mid-table visitors is the backbone of every season. OLBG's lone tipster on this fixture took Perpignan with a 23.5-point start rather than the win, and we would not argue with that framing either. For the match result there is only one side to be on. Selection: Stade Toulousain.

predictions.headline: Francisco Cerundolo to win (match)
predictions.body: Francisco Cerundolo opens Wednesday's play on Centre Court in Brussels at 11:30 as the third seed, and the ATP order of play tells you everything about his opponent's route here: Martin Damm is a lucky loser, meaning he was beaten in the final round of qualifying and only entered the main draw when a spot opened up. A seeded player who earned his place against one who did not win his way in is as lopsided as a last-sixteen draw gets. Selection: Cerundolo to win in straight sets or otherwise, the match line is the play.

predictions.selection: Ottawa Senators to win (money line, incl. OT/SO)
predictions.headline: Ottawa Senators to win (money line, incl. OT/SO)
predictions.body: Ottawa are 6-3-0 through nine games and the reason is in the crease: Linus Ullmark is 6-1-0 with a 1.33 goals-against average and a .945 save percentage, numbers straight from the NHL's own game centre. Florida are no soft touch at 5-2-2 and the Tkachuk brothers are flying — Matthew has 11 points in his last five, Brady six goals — but the Panthers' team save percentage sits at .884 against Ottawa's .903, and the Senators get home ice at the Canadian Tire Centre with Stützle producing six points over the same stretch. Selection: Ottawa on the money line.
